Claim amendment 1 · 2026-11-01T03:55Z · amends claim 6553085655 at the card thread's measured request (`origin/main` `1f1a369b`). Append-only.

1. **Surface, added:** `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx`, the `isMobile && (type === 'grid' || type === 'table')` arm only, for the ENLARGED related tab's face: it hands an `object-grid` node (inline `{ provider: 'value', items }`, the same columns, `onRowClick`) instead of `object-gallery`, so the enlarged tab's phone cards take plugin-grid's card face at the body's full width. Compact related cards stay as they are.
2. **Why:** the enlarged tab's phone cards are not `ObjectGrid` but `ObjectGallery` (wrapper `grid gap-4 p-4`, the measured inset); `plugin-grid` depends on `plugin-detail`, so the face cannot be imported there, and a registry-resolved `object-grid` node avoids the cycle.
3. Card face plan inside `plugin-grid`, as measured: title = declared name field; status chip = the shown column `detectStatusField` (`@object-ui/types`) names, drawn through its desktop cell; subtitle = the first two shown non-title, non-status columns joined with 「 · 」, masked and empty skipped; the per-column lines and the name-keyword stage heuristics go. Tests pinning the old lines are rewritten to the new face.
